pokedexEntries.us: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

pokedexEntries.um: This is Necrozma’s form while it’s absorbing the power of Solgaleo, making it extremely ferocious and impossible to control.

pokedexEntries.sw: When it dominates Solgaleo, it takes on this form. It’s a vicious Pokémon, mangling prey with its many claws—including those on its back.

pokedexEntries.sh: Necrozma has attached itself to Solgaleo. It siphons away its host’s limitless energy, exploiting that energy to fuel a rampage.
